subject: POC trial - environment setup, success criteria & next steps (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finpay.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + success criteria (POC trial)

Thanks again for a great discovery call today - appreciate the context on FinPay's fraud scoring and realtime authorization use cases. Per our conversation, I wanted to recap the proposed evaluation plan and ask a few clarifying questions so we can lock the environment for the POC.

Recap / proposed success criteria:
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 200ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens) under baseline load (1k req/min).
- Throughput: sustain 600 req/min with acceptable tail latency during a 1-hour stress window.
- Accuracy: similarity of top-1 classification/score to your baseline model within +/- 5% on the 500-sample test set you mentioned.
- Cost: projected token/unit cost under expected traffic (we'll provide estimates after we see token distribution).

Environment options (we discussed):
1) Hosted sandbox (Redwood hosted) - fastest to stand up, good for functional and some load tests.
2) Dedicated sandbox (isolated GPU pool) - recommended for stress/perf validation and realistic latency characteristics.
3) VPC trial (customer VPC or on-prem) - required if you need private networking and key control for data residency.

Questions / asks from your side:
- Which environment do you prefer to start with for the first 2 weeks of the POC? (hosted recommended to accelerate start, then dedicated for stress tests)
- Confirm owners: who will be FinPay's technical lead for the POC (name + email) and who owns success criteria/acceptance?
- Can you share the 500-sample test set and the finpay_poc_requirements.xlsx I referenced? (I've attached our mutual action plan and a template).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm environment choice + tech lead by EOD Wed.
- I'll provision hosted sandbox creds immediately and share a short runbook.
- Schedule a 60-min setup session with your engineer + our infra engineer (Vivek) for any dedicated/VPC needs.

Attachments:
- finpay_poc_requirements.xlsx (your checklist)

Thanks - I'll follow up with dates for the setup session once I have your preference.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0187

Thanks Sam - great, that timeline works. I've attached the mutual action plan as a PDF (redwood_poc_mop.pdf) and fleshed out the evaluation plan below.

Evaluation plan (proposed):
Week 0 (setup, 1-2 days):
- Provision hosted sandbox + provide creds and runbook. Smoke tests with sample payloads.
- Confirm tokenization / prompt format and baseline latencies.
\Week 1 (functional validation):
- Run the 500-sample test set for accuracy/comparison metrics.
- Validate integration points and callbacks to FinPay test endpoints.
\Week 2 (performance & stress):
- Provision Dedicated sandbox (2-3 GPU nodes) for throughput validation; run load tests up to 1.5k req/min.
- Capture p50/p95/p99 latency and memory/KV cache behavior.
\Acceptance criteria: all success criteria listed in my initial note met, and no critical integration blockers.
\Owners (proposed):
- FinPay technical lead: Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@finpay.com) - integration and test data owner
- FinPay success owner: Samantha Lee (samantha.lee@finpay.com) - acceptance sign-off
- Redwood contacts: Marissa Cole (AE) - program lead; Vivek Kulkarni (Infra) - infra/ops; Aisha Rahman (CS) - onboarding & enablement
\Requested action: please confirm owners and we'll schedule the setup call (Vivek + Tom).
\Attachments:
- redwood_poc_mop.pdf (mutual action plan, timeline, single page SOW)
\Best,
\Marissa

Subject: Dedicated sandbox sizing and setup windows

Hi Tom/Sam - quick note from the infra side on sizing and the setup call.
\Recommendation for dedicated sandbox for the stress pass:
- GPU profile: 2 x A100 80GB (or equivalent fractional vGPU configuration) to reliably hit 1.5k req/min with low tail latency.
- Node count: start with 2 nodes with autoscaling to 4 for spikes (we can lock max nodes for the POC).
- Disk/network: will require outbound access to your callback endpoints; we support both public egress and VPC peering.
\Setup logistics:
- I can join the setup session Tue 30 Jun or Wed 1 Jul (window 10am-1pm PT). Please confirm Tom's availability.
- For VPC trial: we'll need your networking team to open ports and share the VPC CIDR; that process usually adds ~3 business days.
\Shared resources:
- Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodFinPayPOC (config templates, runbook)
- Perf runbook: redwood_poc_mop.pdf (attached in Marissa's previous email)
\If you prefer hosted-first, we'll provision creds immediately and keep the dedicated sandbox window ready for the Week 2 run.
\Thanks,
Vivek
